## 🧠 RAG Vector Database
- HTTP query tới local SQLite vector DB: /search
- CRUD API: /upsert, DELETE /documents/{id}, /documents
- Output: bestFaq, bestProduct, rag_context, rag_chunks, vector_db

## 🤖 LLM Answer Generator (Gemini/RAG)
- Model: Google Gemini (gemini-flash-latest) / OpenAI
- System Prompt: Tổng hợp từ rag_context
- Trích dẫn nguồn: FAQ F01, CATALOG-P01

## ⚖️ LLM-as-Judge Evaluator (Gemini)
- Gọi gemini-flash-latest để chấm groundedness/confidence
- Input: question + answer + rag_context + sources_used
- Output: judge_score, confidence, need_human
